big_case.notes: Formed from the record and the outcome: a Pacific Legal Foundation petition asking the Court to overrule PruneYard on Takings and compelled-speech grounds, with four cert-stage amicus briefs and a published state appellate opinion, but a private-party dispute in an interlocutory preliminary-injunction posture with no federal split. A grant would have had national doctrinal reach over state speech-access regimes, which keeps the read above the median paid petition; the Court's treatment (denied at the long conference on first distribution, no relist, no noted dissent) shows it was not regarded as a pressing vehicle, which keeps it well short of the top band.
